fusions.name: Squeaked Incantation
fusions.desc: Your familiar rat carries a practised word to the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Whispered Hex
fusions.desc: A weapon strike your familiar whispers a hex onto: it deals 12 damage, knocks the target 2 tiles back and leaves it [Hexed] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Prompted From the Shoulder
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 25% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Apprentice in the Pocket
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded rat familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds at enemies within 5 tiles.
